evidence_scope: read-only source comparison, zero target object internal verification

gates.subject: container format
gates.facts: HDR 0500 selects PB5 layout; HDR 0600 can occur in ANSI or Unicode containers

gates.subject: object p-code profile
gates.facts: object versions 79,114,146,166,193,196 select Parser90; 238 selects Parser100; 283 Parser105; 316,319,321,322,325,333,334 Parser110
gates.warning: Parser90 class name does not make all these versions PB9

gates.subject: function definition width
gates.facts: version>146 uses48; older non-PB5 uses44; PB5 uses32

gates.subject: timestamp width
gates.facts: PbdViewer adds an extra u32 after each timestamp for object version>=334; legacy Python only branches on h1==335
gates.warning: Boundary discrepancy requires raw version and structural validation; do not guess a universal layout

gates.subject: Parser90 operand exception
gates.facts: opcode297 uses zero operand words when version<193, otherwise its base table says one

gates.subject: Parser100 translation
gates.facts: op<=26 forwards unchanged; op>=29 forwards op-2; 27/28 lack inherited semantic handler

gates.subject: Parser105 translation
gates.facts: op2..549 maps to parent op-1; 0/1 have separate return rules

gates.subject: Parser110 translation
gates.facts: through408 unchanged; through416 +1; through419 +2; higher +3 relative to parent semantics

gates.subject: ANSI versus Unicode
gates.facts: Sybase10.5 release bulletin says PB9 and earlier PBDs use ANSI; PB10+ requires regenerated Unicode PBDs
gates.warning: ANSI is not an identified code page; do not unconditionally use host Encoding.Default

gates.subject: static calls and polymorphism
gates.facts: Official language documentation says STATIC object lookup still permits an override on a descendant runtime instance
gates.warning: A compile-time slot/name does not prove the unique runtime callee
